label: Last copy step of length-4 sequences when the fed-back input (orig token 2) is 1/h/f/j/n/e/0/z/o
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost always on the final output step (to_go==0 holds 91% of mass, to_go==1 most of the rest). It is concentrated on L=4 (84% of mass, t=7, recall_idx=3), with weaker firing at the last or second-to-last copy step for L=3 and L=5; it is nearly silent for L>=6. Inside that slot it depends on the token: the fed-back input (original token 2) is most often 1, h, f, j (each roughly 4-5x lift), then n, e, 0, z, o. The output token (original token 3) also matters, with f, j, h, e, z elevated; the top activations are inputs h/1/j with output f. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases or on the first occurrence of a token. Since the slot alone has precision 0.32, token identity is what drives most of the selectivity. The token set gives precision about 0.8 but leaves out the L=3/5 firings and other tokens. Magnitude is highest for L=4 and the 1/h/f/j inputs.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=7: 1, f, j, h; t=8: h, 1, f, j; t=9: 1, j, h, f) and the token being output (most: f, j, e, h, z, n; least: t, d, s, w); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=7, recall_idx=4, to_go=0.
